added_lines: " HOPE TO SEE YOU ALL THERE !" Garnish GAA – Annual General Meeting: The Garnish GAAAGM will take place on Sunday, 29th November at 3.00pm in the Clubhouse . All members are warmly welcome, and anyone interested in getting involved with is encouraged to come along. Your support and participation are always welcome! Beara West Resource Centre Services November Winter talks- Mondays 4-6pm We have three informative talks this November that can make a real differe nce to you and your family. Monday, 30 November - Sergeant Steven Gloss and an AIB representative will inform you how to spot scams, stay safe online and protect yourself from fraud. Please note a minim um of 8 attendees are required for these talks to go ahead. Beara West Resource Centre Services: Knitting Circle- Tuesdays 2.30- 4.30 pm until the 24th of November . Our Knitting circle is an 8-week community group, creating hats, s carves, and cardigans to donate to the Cork Penny Dinners Christmas Appeal. This group is welcome to beginners as well as experienced knitters. Beara West provides materials. Beara West Resource Centre Services: Beara West Carers Circle: Our monthly coffee and chat takes place the first Monday of every month. Our next group will take place on the 7th Of December. This month’s group will be partaking in a Christmas wreath making workshop, With Eileen O’Connor. This is a peer support group, to connect with other carers f or a cuppa and a chat. New members are always welcome. “May we find joy in the little blessings of each day, and share kindness, hope and love wherever life leads us.” Allihies

Mass for the Deceased of the Past Year , On Thursday the 19th of November 7pm, we will remember in a special way all our faithful departed who have gone to their eternal rest during the last year.
Relatives and friends are warmly invited to attend this Memorial Mass during which a candle will be lit for each of the departed and their names will be remembered in prayer.
You are welcome to then take the candle home.
